svg.title: ReasonAI Web architecture: Next.js, Konva, Pyodide, Go collaboration, LangGraph, Nemotron, Tavily and Nebius ConTree Sandbox
svg.desc: In-depth ReasonAI Web architecture. React Next.js web browser includes Feed, DSA Monaco editor with Pyodide local Run, and System Design Konva canvas. Supabase Auth signs requests. Next.js Vercel Node runtime orchestrates bounded LangGraph AI, research and execution APIs. FastAPI Cloud Run provides product data and deterministic knowledge ranking backed by PostgreSQL and Cloudflare R2. Go WebSockets on Render handles transient collaboration. Nemotron models run through Nebius Token Factory; search_web calls execute Tavily server-side. Vercel Queue dispatches Submit to disposable network-disabled Nebius ConTree Python sandboxes; deterministic judge outside sandbox persists verdict, followed by Nemotron Code Intelligence. Offline refresh job uses Tavily news and Nemotron enrichment. Model suggestions require human approval and sandbox operation status is not the judge verdict.

g.text: Real engineering workspaces · deterministic execution · model-assisted decisions
One authenticated product shell with three independent engineering experiences
NEXT.JS APP ROUTER · REACT 19 · TYPESCRIPT · TANSTACK QUERY
Stories · filters · saved state · Ask ReasonAI
Public Pyodide Run · Submit · Results Studio
Supabase OAuth / session · server-owned identity · browser interactions & editor drafts
Cloudflare R2 serves processed Feed images
NDJSON events · durable run state · LangSmith
Accepted canvas edits → normal shared ops
Only trusted server handlers call Nebius, Tavily or persistence tools
Typed ops · user accepts or discards
Sources are untrusted · model text is not a judge verdict · proposals never directly mutate the Konva document
Local Run executes in-browser. Authenticated Submit is dispatched to disposable Nebius ConTree sandbox.
ConTree operation SUCCESS does not mean the submitted solution passed; judging is performed outside the VM.
AI proposes · deterministic systems execute · users decide
